content: Mosir azadit mojbut tako
Mosiye ãrare ainottu azad goijje zene ãra azad taki fari. Hetolla tũwara mojbut tako, edde tũwara abar gulamir zuwãlor tole oi no zaiyogoi.
Funo! ãi Paulos tũwarare hoir, tũwara zodi azomi goro, toile Mosiye tũwarare hono faida no dibo.
Ãi abar ei goba di hoir, ze honokiye azomi gora, hitattu baiddoi Torar ainor hár hokum mana fore.
Tũwara zara Torar ain falon gori forhesgar oito sor, tũwara Mosittu alok. Tũwara Allar doyattu forigiyogoi.
Kiyollahoile ãra zani ze Allaye ãrare forhesgar hisabe gosibo. Ei aša loi ãra Pak Ruhur duwara biššaš loi entezar gori asi.
Kiyollahoile Mosi Isar butore azomi goijja ba agoijja hono forok nai. Asol oilde biššaš, ziyan muhabbotor duwara ham gore.
Tũwara to bala fõtot solat aššila! Ei soyi manattu tũwarare hone tiya goraifelaiye?
Zibaye tũwarare ḍaikke iyan hibar torfottu aiššede no.
Monot raikko ze, ekkanagori iše gũṛa hãiyore fulaitule.
Ãttu Malikor uwore tũwarar babute furafuri biššaš ase ze, tũwara oinno ar hono ḍoilla šikka no gosiba. Ar ze tũwarare olzuwolot felar, hite ze oibo ok, hite šaza faibo.

Báiboinain okkol, zodi ãi ehono azomi gora dorhar hoi šikka didde oile, toile ãre ehono kiyolla zulum gora or? Hen oito bolide Mosir kurušor babute tobolig goitte hono banda no oito edde hiyanot manuš okkol gušša no oito.
Hitara zara tũwarare azomi gora loi olzuwolot felar, ãi issa gori, hitarar nizor boda udda haṛi felok.
Tũwara Pak Ruhur duwara zibon haṛo
O báiboinain okkol, tũwarare azadit ḍaka oiyede, ar he azadire tũwara nizor monor issa mozin bebar no goijjo, bolke muhabbot loi ekzone ar ekzonor šeba goro.
Kiyollahoile Torar ain beggun ei ekkan hokum falon gora loi furon o, hiyan oilde, "Tũi tũwar ḍen gór bam gójjare nizor ḍoilla muhabbot goro."
Ar tũwara zodi ekzone ar ekzon loi hõrahõri edde rišariši goro, hušiyar, hendila gorile tũwara ekzone ar ekzonore dongšo gori felaiba.
Hetolla ãi tũwarare ei hota hoir, tũwara Pak Ruhur duwara zibon haṛo, henoile tũwara nizor monor issa furon no goriba.

Kiyollahoile ziyan manuš zatir issa hiyan Pak Ruhur issar ulda, ar ziyan Pak Ruhur issa hiyan manuš zatir issar ulda. In ekkan loi ekkan no bone, iyanor mani tũwarattu ziyan goitto mone ho he issa mozin gori no fariba.
Ar tũwara zodi Pak Ruhur duwara zibon haṛo, toile tũwara Torar ainor tole no.
Manuš zatir bod issa okkol ki ki iyan beši foriškar, hin okkol oilde: Zena, nafaki ham, kukiyal,
muttifũza, zadu bidda, dušmonai, hoilhoijja, riš, gušša, šude nizor balailla bafa, faṭa faṭi, edde gurup gurup owa.

Ar ekzonor zinišor uwore lalsi, niša hái fol owa, bodmaši rong ḍongor aḍḍa, ar endilla aro bout kissu. Zinor babute ãi tũwarare age loti hušiyar gori diyi, hendila abar o hušiyar gori dir ze, zara endilla horaf ham okkol gore hitara Allar raijjot goli no faribo.
Pak Ruhur fól okkol
Ar Pak Ruhur fól oilde in: Muhabbot, kuši, šanti, bordaš, ador doya, balai, biššaš,
norom gori sola, edde nizore sõli raka. In okkolor ulda hono ain nai.
Ar hitara zara Mosi Isar manuš, hitara nizor gare edde hiyanor hár horaf hamor issa okkolore marifelaiye.
Ãra zodi Pak Ruhur duwara zinda, toile ãra Pak Ruhur dehai diya mozin soli.
Aiyo, ãra borai no gori, ekzone ar ekzonore gušša tuli no di edde riš no gori.
